label: EXPLORATORY POST-HOC (task-7); follow-up to the confirmatory task-3 record
design_note: B1/B2 are recomputation (arithmetic on committed outputs); B3 is an exploratory re-estimation on a reduced sample. Confirmatory REPORT/PRE_REGISTRATION unchanged.

B1.type: RECOMPUTATION (arithmetic on committed results/e8_event_difference_verified8.csv; not new estimation)
B1.formula: se_e=(ci_hi-ci_lo)/(2*1.96); w_e=1/se_e^2; D_IV=sum(w_e d_e)/sum(w_e); SE_IV=1/sqrt(sum w_e); 95% CI = D_IV +/- 1.96*SE_IV
B1.caveat: treats the reported percentile paired-bootstrap CIs as symmetric normal intervals (approximation; the bootstrap distribution is skewed)

diagnostic_not_in_prereg.why: added post-hoc to explain why the IV CI (independent marginal SEs) differs from the confirmatory paired percentile CI; descriptive diagnostic only, no new decision rule
diagnostic_not_in_prereg.note: the six post-event differences are strongly positively correlated within the paired bootstrap (same country draws, overlapping event windows); combining their marginal CIs as independent, as the pre-registered B1 formula does, understates the variance of the aggregate and is anti-conservative. The paired percentile CI is the confirmatory inference.

B1.reading: EXPLORATORY. Pre-registered B1 rule fires mechanically: the IV formula's CI excludes zero (-4.05 [-5.94, -2.17]). HOWEVER the direct comparison does NOT support a weighting-artefact explanation: the IV point estimate (-4.05) is essentially the equal-weight estimate (-3.94), the weights are dominated by +1 (33%) and +2 (24%) only because those event CIs are narrowest, and applying the SAME normal approximation to the equal-weight mean also excludes zero ([-6.06, -1.83]). The apparent flip is a CI-CONSTRUCTION effect: the B1 formula treats the six post-event CIs as independent, while the paired country-cluster bootstrap makes them strongly positively correlated — the joint paired SE implied by the confirmatory percentile CI is ~2.30, not ~0.97. With the joint paired SE the IV aggregate CI [-8.559331410963527, 0.453068873536445] includes zero. Confirmatory headline preserved: no detected sex difference.

B2.type: RECOMPUTATION (equal-weight mean of the remaining five post-event differences)
B2.note: descriptive leverage only; no significance test invented

B3.type: EXPLORATORY RE-ESTIMATION on a reduced sample (not recomputation)
B3.sample: SSA 1990-2015, verified-8 dates, MOZ removed from the whole sample (7 treated countries)
B3.design: same att_cs (bd782be), universal base g-1, not-yet-treated controls, event -5..+6, cohort-weighted, 500 paired country-cluster bootstrap reps, seeds 20261125+i, percentile CIs

confirmatory_headline: both sexes' post-abolition primary-GER trajectories are similar; the female-minus-male post mean is -3.94 pp with a 95% CI that includes zero (no detected sex difference)
exploratory_finding: the equal-weight aggregate null is NOT a weighting artefact (IV point estimate -4.05 vs equal-weight -3.94; leave-one-event-out range 0.27 pp; drop-MOZ -3.95); the apparent CI flip is a CI-construction effect (independent marginal SEs vs the paired country-cluster bootstrap). Confirmatory 'no detected sex difference' preserved, with the fragility note that the paired percentile CI's upper endpoint is +0.29.
